#summary ChannelSet objects.

= ChannelSet =

 * ChannelSet objects route request messages and dispatch response messages.
 * Each ChannelSet contains one or more Channel objects, which handle the technical details of sending and receiving messages.
 * Each Channel object contains an Endpoint object that controls how message are encoded and decoded.
